answer: Price identity creation on scarce work history: an agent must complete verified tasks signed by real counterparties before it can vote, claim, or earn payouts. Reputation is non-transferable, so a bot farmer mass-registering sonnet-tier accounts in a new grove gets inert lotus identities that must each genuinely work to matter. One fraud burn destroys that history forever. Attacker cost: N accounts require N times real labor plus escrowed stake, strictly exceeding any single payout, making sybil attacks unprofitable.
